notes.title: January 16 Patch
notes.notes:
→ Arthur’s punishment is working properly again. This technique can now give Arthur up to 3 times 6 health points. Finally, the target of the punishment is no longer enraging but scared, sticking better to the idea of making it a technique for tanker

→ The monkey now learns his 1st technique against the 2nd boss, it is with this last one that the boss must be shocked in order to be defeated.

→ I have recruited another translator for the English version, the prologue is being rewritten, I hope that will suit you!

notes.title: First patch of the year!
notes.notes:
The game is more stable, whatever your operating system.

I continue to devote time to the optimization of CESSPOOL, soon I will smooth the curve dee difficulty and improved some techniques. 

Thanks to the peak sale during the winter sales, a new English translation and also in progress, I hope you will like it;)

Tryton

notes.title: Sunny afternoon patch :)
notes.notes:
ITEMS
Sliders targeting characters disappear correctly when using a crumb moon

MOOD

notes.title: Patch for the weekend!
notes.notes:
I’ve been rewriting character emotion information to make it more discreet.
I also did a lot of small corrections. (typo, difficulty balance, ...)

If at the end of the weekend, no one has found access to the WEIRD ROAD, I simplify its access and I add clues, I want you to enjoy the 3rd dungeon and the real final boss! : )

Do not hesitate to leave a review if you enjoy the game! 

Have a good weekend! ;D
